messages:
Sam R: Heads-up, LedgerSight sent a renewal+pilot bundle for our billing reconciliation tool evaluation. highlights: 6-mo pilot, 2M tokens/mo committed, $16 / 1M committed, $26 overage, $4k onboarding. vendor prefers annual prepay for best price but will accept PO/net-30. quote: https://vendor-quotes.internal/ledgersight/2067
Ivy C: can you paste the quick math and sample invoice lines? need to map to GL and check VAT rules.
Sam R: pasted sample lines from quote:
```
line_item,units,unit_price,amount
committed_tokens,2000000,16,32.00
overage_tokens,0,26,0.00
onboarding_fee,1,4000,4000.00
```
Dana (Fin): finance checklist: confirm billing entity, whether onboarding can be credited, tax handling (EU VAT), and that they accept PO/net-30. cap for finance-only approval: $120k TCV.
Victor (Eng): product question: do they export per-request token counts with our hashed request id? we need that to reconcile.
Sam R: asked vendor for per-request export + schema. vendor replied they can include hashed_id and per-request tokens; SOC2 available and DPA will be provided.
procure-bot: Reminder: create PR ticket before legal review: /po create <vendor> <amount> <budget-code>.
Ivy C: negotiating plan: request onboarding waived, 10% pilot discount or 6-month term with 30-day opt-out after month 2. aim to start pilot by 2026-05-01.
Dana (Fin): conditional approval: if vendor accepts PO/net-30, waives onboarding or credits it, provides SOC2/DPA, and TCV <= $115k, finance signs. Upload W-9 and billing entity to PR.
Sam R: created PR-2026-333 and linked quote. will push vendor for credit and hashed_id export. will post vendor confirmation here.
Victor (Eng): once we get sample CSV i'll run reconciliation script; estimate 5 business days to validate.
Ivy C: noted. will draft negotiation email and loop legal after vendor confirms billing entity and PO terms. :thumbsup:
